newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Producer sells Tapis at $1.40/bbl premium.
newsitem.headline: Producer sells Tapis at $1.40/bbl premium.

text.p: A producer has sold 300,000 barrels of November Tapis crude oil to a trader at a market premium over benchmark quotes of $1.40, industry sources said on Friday.
They said the Tapis is destined for Burma, which tendered to buy Tapis crude oil on a delivered basis, they said.
The last Tapis deal was at a $1.20 premium fob to a Korean buyer.
The premium has risen steadily during trading for November barrels, reflecting strong demand for the middle distllate rich crude.
